**Avoid this shop.**

Year 1: We got a flat shortly after buying a new car and had it fixed here. A few more flats followed, and based on their recommendation we replaced all four tires with their "Premier snow and mud" tires.

Year 2: Three to four more slow leaking flats in a single year — each time we were told it was a "different tire." On the last visit I watched the technician and was told the flat was in the exact same spot as the previous repair. I saw that the spot had been patched multiple times over. So much for "different tires."

The owner then told me the hole was too big to fix and pushed me to buy a used tire from them and sign a waiver — despite the fact that they had sold us the full new set the year before. I declined and asked them to put the old patch back so I could drive to another shop. The technician said it was already patched but it wasn't holding.

I took the tire to a different shop. They inspected it and found no leak at all. The tire was fine.

So: repeat patches on the same spot while being told they were "different tires," a false claim that the tire was unfixable, a pitch to sell me a used tire, and likely an unnecessary new set the year before. I don't know how they have the ratings they do. Take your car somewhere else.
